evidence.excerpt: Kmeťová provided technical consulting to a regional laboratory software vendor over an 18-month period (2020–2021), advising on the integration of automated flagging algorithms into their laboratory information management system. The engagement resulted in a co-authored technical report and an ongoing data-access agreement used in the CLASSLAB project.
